description: Exceptional 3-bedroom air-conditioned apartment, completely new (April 2024), ideally located in the heart of Paris, just steps from rue Montorgueil, Place des Victoires, and the Opéra district. Combining luxury, comfort, and modernity, it was designed and decorated by renowned architects and is fully equipped. A truly outstanding place for an unforgettable stay in Paris with family or friends.The space✨ Stunning 99 m² Air-Conditioned Apartment – Elegance & Comfort in the Heart of Paris ✨📍 An exceptional setting in a charming Parisian stone buildingLocated on the 1st floor with elevator of a beautiful and secure Haussmann-style building, nestled in a quiet and elegant courtyard, this 99 m² apartment offers a rare combination of space, light, and refined design.Beautifully decorated and fully equipped, it blends Parisian charm with modern comfort and can accommodate up to 8 guests.🏠 A spacious and refined layout:✔ Bright and elegant living room with sofa bed, armchairs, and coffee table – perfect for relaxing after a day in the city.✔ Dining area with a beautiful table and chairs for 8 guests.✔ Smart TV and Wi-Fi access to stay connected and entertained.✔ Fully equipped open-plan kitchen featuring refrigerator, stovetop, microwave, dishwasher, washer-dryer, Nespresso coffee machine, kettle, and toaster.✔ First double bedroom with queen-size bed, smart TV, and en-suite bathroom with shower and sink.✔ Second double bedroom with queen-size bed, smart TV, and en-suite bathroom with shower, sink, and WC.✔ Third double bedroom with queen-size bed and smart TV.✔ Additional bathroom with shower and sink.✔ Separate WC for added convenience.🌟 Highlights you’ll love:✔ Fully air-conditioned apartment for year-round comfort.✔ Three spacious bedrooms, perfect for families or groups.✔
